scripts.translation: 那么，冒险者，请从霓虹蘑菇身上收集10份发光孢子，另从甜梦魇身上收集10簇梦魇鬃毛。 ^0000cd^000000^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: I can tell that's not enough, just by looking at it.
scripts.translation: 光看一眼就知道这点东西不够。

scripts.text: Oh, you're right. You must have forgotten what I asked.
scripts.translation: 哦，你说得对。你肯定忘了我拜托你的事。

scripts.text: Please bring me ^0000cd10 Shining Spores^000000 from Neon Mushrooms and ^0000cd10 Clusters of Nightmares^000000 from Sweet Nightmares. Thank you.
scripts.translation: 请从霓虹蘑菇身上收集10份发光孢子，另从甜梦魇身上收集10簇梦魇鬃毛。拜托了。 ^0000cd^000000^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: I can tell he brought everything you asked. Come on, make a paste and apply it to the wall already.
scripts.translation: 看得出来他把你要的东西都带来了。快调好浆糊，涂到墙上吧。

scripts.text: Adventurer, thank you for helping me study. These glowing spores don't last long. Could you come back tomorrow and get me more of them?
scripts.translation: 冒险者，谢谢你帮我研究。这些发光孢子撑不了多久，明天能再帮我找一些吗？

scripts.text: This orb needs more time to gather enough energy before it'll work.
scripts.translation: 这颗宝珠还需要些时间聚集能量，之后才能使用。

scripts.text: ^4d4dffYou must be level 120 or higher to enter this area.^000000
scripts.translation: 进入此区域需要达到120级。 ^4d4dff^000000

scripts.text: ^ff0000I feel dazed, as if I'm dreaming.^000000
scripts.translation: 我一阵恍惚，感觉自己像是在做梦。 ^ff0000^000000

scripts.text: I'm carrying too many types of items. I should lighten my bag first.
scripts.translation: 我携带的物品种类太多了，得先清一下背包。

scripts.text: I have all the twigs I need. I should go back to Zeith and Vrid.
scripts.translation: 树枝已经收集够了，该回去找泽伊特和弗里德了。

scripts.text: I checked the mound of dirt to look for twigs.
scripts.translation: 我检查了一下土堆，看看能不能找到树枝。

scripts.text: There's nothing inside this mound of dirt.
scripts.translation: 这个土堆里什么也没有。

scripts.text: Um.. Are you an adventurer?? I have a favor to ask you...
scripts.translation: 呃......你是冒险者吗？我有件事想拜托你......

scripts.text: ...Oh, you need more experience. Excuse me.
scripts.translation: ......哦，你还需要积累些经验。抱歉

scripts.text: - ^0000CDLevel 150 and over can do this quest.^000000 -
scripts.translation: - 等级达到150级以上才能接取此任务。 - ^0000CD^000000

scripts.text: I am from the Alberta Guard of the 1st Knights Division, Knight Aylvar.
scripts.translation: 我是第一骑士团艾尔贝塔卫队的骑士艾尔瓦。

scripts.text: Under the command of the Knights, I am on a mission to search for Alberta's 2nd Knights Division, who had disappeared in Turtle Island.
scripts.translation: 我奉骑士团之命，前来搜寻在海龟岛失踪的艾尔贝塔第二骑士团。途中遭遇猛烈

scripts.text: However, after meeting a violent storm, I arrived at a Turtle Island, but it didn't seem like the normal Turtle Island.
scripts.translation: 风暴，醒来时我已身在一座海龟岛上，但那里似乎并非平常的海龟岛。

scripts.text: I was in danger, but someone helped me out.
scripts.translation: 我当时身陷险境，幸好有人救了我。

scripts.text: As I woke up, I felt the sea breeze from Alberta's harbor... In my hands, two pieces of this turtle shell.
scripts.translation: 醒来时，我感受到艾尔贝塔港口吹来的海风......手里还握着两块这样的龟壳碎片。

scripts.text: Here is only one piece I have right now.
scripts.translation: 我现在只剩一块。另一块

scripts.text: My friend might have the other one. No, I mean he must still have.
scripts.translation: 也许在我朋友手里。不，我相信他一定还拿着。
你的朋友遇到危险了吗？

scripts.text: I understand. Even for me, I am bewildered, but please hear me out. I think my friend is in danger
scripts.translation: 我明白。连我自己都觉得不可思议，但请听我说完。我觉得朋友现在有危险。

scripts.text: Yes, it's about my friend. Sorry for such a long story, just a little more, hear me out.
scripts.translation: 是关于我朋友的事。抱歉说了这么久，再听我多说几句。

scripts.text: I show these pieces to my friend, ^0000CDLeiphen^000000.
scripts.translation: 我把这些碎片给朋友莱芬 ^0000CD^000000

scripts.text: He shows big interest. ^0000CDHe said that it was made from the shell of a turtle living only on Turtle Island.
scripts.translation: 0000看。他非常感兴趣，说这是生活在海龟岛的一种海龟的龟壳制成的。 ^0000CD

scripts.text: After I handed the pieces to him....
My friend Leiphen who was looking at the pieces suddenly disappeared.
scripts.translation: ....正在查看碎片的莱芬突然消失了。

scripts.text: In the meantime, I contacted Juno University and went to Turtle Island, but I haven't achieved any results... I was hoping I could find a clue so I figure out where Leiphen disappeared to.
scripts.translation: 00000发生的事。这期间我联系了朱诺大学，也去了海龟岛调查，却毫无进展......我希望能找到线索，查明莱芬消失去了哪里。

scripts.text: {0}, please help us. Can you help me find my friend?
scripts.translation: {0}，请帮帮我们。能帮我找到朋友吗？

scripts.text: This piece might be a clue. Please take a look.
scripts.translation: 这块龟壳碎片或许能提供线索，请看看。

scripts.text: Please tell me your friend looks like.
^0000CDHe wears glasses^000000 and has blue short hair. ^0000CDHis face is just like a scholar^000000 so you should be able to recognize him.
scripts.translation: 他戴着眼镜，留着蓝色短发。看起来像个学者，应该很好认。 ^0000CD^000000^0000CD^000000

scripts.text: Show me the piece. Let me take a look.
I am sorry, {0}. You already have too much stuff. I figure it's difficult to find my friend right now.
scripts.translation: 抱歉，{0}。你身上东西太多了，恐怕没法马上去找我朋友。

scripts.text: Can you clear up your inventory a little bit? I will be right here waiting for you.
scripts.translation: 能清理一下物品栏吗？我会在这里等你。

scripts.text: - ^424242I grabbed the piece handed over by the knight. A small leaf is carved on the turtle shell. It's a bulky piece, but somehow feels warm.^000000 -
scripts.translation: - 我接过骑士递来的碎片。龟壳上刻着一片小叶子。碎片虽然沉重，却不知为何透着暖意。 - ^424242^000000

scripts.text: - ^424242I was looking at the piece for a while, but suddenly something seemed to appear in my head. Suddenly a gust blows and my vision gets darker.^000000 -
scripts.translation: - 我盯着碎片看了一会儿，脑海中突然浮现出什么。紧接着一阵风吹来，视线也逐渐暗了下去。 - ^424242^000000

scripts.text: - ^424242EAylvar's voice is getting smaller and I felt dizzy. It's starting to smell like wet clay....^000000 -
scripts.translation: - 艾尔瓦的声音渐渐远去，我感到一阵眩晕，空气中开始弥漫湿泥土的气味...... - ^424242^000000

scripts.text: {0}! Oh, you are ok! I am... worried. After Leiphen, {1}, you also disappeared, I was really concerned.

scripts.translation: 慢。就算你是位智者，也不代表你有权在这里随意走动。

scripts.translation: 吗？请告诉我。我这是在哪里？刚才发生了什么？

scripts.translation: 别说？我又没说错。你很快就会离开，把一切都忘掉。你再也不会回来......对吧？

scripts.translation: ......随你怎么想吧，觉得我傲慢也好，不傲慢也罢。我才不在乎。

scripts.text: You want that, but still someone is going to come back here.

scripts.translation: 这里的居民都是被怨念束缚的灵魂。人死后若对某件事怀有强烈执念，就会在无意识中不断重复同一件事......

scripts.text: We hate life. Those who are not bound by the burden of resentment, those who breathe strangely. We want to hear your last breath.
scripts.translation: 我们憎恨活人。那些没有被怨念束缚、呼吸方式古怪的人——我们想听见他们咽下最后一口气。不过只

scripts.text: It doesn't last long. The longer you stay here, the more you notice each other. Gradually.
scripts.translation: 这种状态不会持续太久。你在这里待得越久，彼此就越能渐渐察觉对方。然后

scripts.translation: 之前也有人来过这里，不过很少见。第一次看到有人时，我想起了自己的愿望。

scripts.translation: 过了这么久，我还是没有失去理智。我没有被怨念吞噬，也没有丧失理性或情感。

scripts.text: So I want to save all life. Those who have flowed in and even those trapped by the burden forever.
scripts.translation: 所以我想救下所有人——误入这里的人，还有永远被怨念困住的灵魂。

scripts.text: It's... it's hard. Even I envy those trapped by this burden. But... I couldn't turn it off. The people who are in danger.
scripts.translation: 这......真的很难。我甚至羡慕那些被怨念困住的人。可我没法对身处险境的人袖手旁观。......

scripts.text: But I don't want to hope. If you hope... you can be betrayed.
scripts.translation: 我不敢抱有希望。因为一旦有了希望，就可能遭到背叛。

scripts.translation: 啊，我差点忘了。让我再施一次咒语保护你，不过它很弱，持续不了多久。

scripts.text: That sounds like something similar could happen in the future, right?
scripts.translation: 听起来未来也可能发生类似的事，对吧？

scripts.text: I apologize. Deep down, I felt that it was annoying for adventurers to talk to me. Now, I'll ask you first.
scripts.translation: 抱歉，其实以前我觉得冒险者来找我说话挺烦的。以后我会主动问你。

scripts.text: If you ever go through something similar, please let me know. I'm begging you.
scripts.translation: 下次要是再遇到类似的事，记得告诉我。拜托了。

scripts.text: Reported to Luanda and gained experience.
scripts.translation: 向卢安达报告，获得了经验值。

scripts.text: Told him about Karoo and Asudem.
scripts.translation: 我把卡鲁和阿苏德姆的事告诉了他。

scripts.text: Puhahaha I think you came to see the place where Hyung-nim and sister-in-law are dating.
scripts.translation: 噗哈哈，你是去看哥哥和嫂子约会的地方吧？

scripts.text: Oh my gosh.. that place is where my brother and sister-in-law often went on dates.
scripts.translation: 天哪......那地方确实是哥哥和嫂子常去约会的地方。

scripts.text: My brother might think it's a secret place only he knows, but it's a place everyone in the village knows.
scripts.translation: 哥哥可能以为那是只有他知道的秘密地点，其实村里人人都知道。

scripts.text: It's quite a popular spot among village lovers. It's quiet and a good place for a date.
scripts.translation: 那地方在村里的情侣之间很受欢迎，既安静又适合约会。

scripts.text: Recently, I haven't had much to laugh about because of various things, but thanks to you, I laughed out loud. I look forward to the next story.
scripts.translation: 最近各种烦心事让我都笑不出来了，多亏你让我开怀大笑。期待下次听到你的故事。

scripts.text: Reported to Luanda and gained experience.
scripts.translation: 向卢安达报告，获得了经验值。

scripts.text: Told Luanda about who was painting murals in the cave.
scripts.translation: 我把在洞穴里画壁画的人告诉了卢安达。

scripts.text: Have you ever met me when I was painting the mural? I don't remember, but...
scripts.translation: 你见过我画壁画吗？我不记得了，不过......

scripts.text: I think I can tell you why I painted the mural.
scripts.translation: 我想我可以告诉你自己为什么要画那幅壁画。

scripts.text: It's not much of a secret, but each of my brothers has a mysterious ability.
scripts.translation: 这不是什么秘密，我的每个兄弟都有一种不可思议的能力。

scripts.text: In the case of Karoo-hyung, he has the ability to see accurately even from a distance..
scripts.translation: 比如卡鲁哥哥，他能从很远的地方看清事物......

scripts.text: Maknae Maru has an excellent memory that never forgets what she has seen and the ability to read her opponent's mind..
scripts.translation: 最小的玛鲁记忆力惊人，见过的东西都不会忘，还能读懂对手的心思......

scripts.text: I'm not always correct, but I can see into the future. Ah! I have more abilities than that.
scripts.translation: 我虽然不能总是预测准确，却能预见未来。啊，我还有别的能力呢。

scripts.text: I can see people's good and evil energy. In the case of adventurers...
scripts.translation: 我能看见人身上的善恶气息。至于冒险者嘛......

scripts.text: I can feel the good energy that can't be touched. That's why I feel more bitter.
scripts.translation: 我能感受到那种看不见、摸不着的善意。所以才觉得格外苦涩。

scripts.text: Coming back to the original story, the reason I'm painting the mural is because one day I dreamed of a village burning down.
scripts.translation: 说回壁画吧，我会画它，是因为有一天梦见村庄被大火吞噬。

scripts.text: Many monsters have come to town and people are crying out in pain because of it...
scripts.translation: 许多魔物涌进村子，村民们痛苦地哀嚎......

scripts.text: After the hellish dream, I saw myself recording the day's events on a mural in a cave.
scripts.translation: 那场地狱般的梦之后，我又看见自己在洞穴壁画上记录那天发生的事。

scripts.text: Haha, don't worry too much. The dream hasn't happened yet.
scripts.translation: 哈哈，别太担心，梦里的事还没发生呢。

scripts.text: Do you know? If I paint the mural in advance, will the future I saw in my dream change?
scripts.translation: 你说，要是我提前画好壁画，梦里看到的未来会不会改变？

scripts.text: An adventurer I haven't seen in my dreams is helping us, so I'm sure we can change it.
scripts.translation: 有位我从没在梦里见过的冒险者正在帮助我们，所以我相信未来能改变。

scripts.text: Reported to Luanda and gained experience.
scripts.translation: 向卢安达报告，获得了经验值。

scripts.text: Told Luanda about Mao, who was training alone.
scripts.translation: 我把毛独自训练的事告诉了卢安达。

scripts.text: Mao guy... you've been thinking about a lot of things.
scripts.translation: 毛那家伙......你倒是想了不少事啊。

scripts.text: Brother Karu lives separately from his sister-in-law, and we still live together, but I don't think he cared too much about his sister.
scripts.translation: 卡鲁哥哥和嫂子分开住，我们还住在一起。不过我觉得他不怎么关心妹妹。

scripts.text: It's said that I lost my mind after having a painful dream, but somehow my anxiety...
scripts.translation: 听说我做了个痛苦的梦后就失去了理智，可不知为何，我还是觉得不安......

scripts.text: Looks like he's been infested with Mao. Maybe because of his abilities, he's often swayed by other people's emotions...
scripts.translation: 他似乎被毛的情绪影响了。也许是因为有那种能力，他总会受到别人的情绪左右......

scripts.text: He... training to become stronger... even if he doesn't become stronger... he's still enough...
scripts.translation: 他......为了变强而训练......可就算没变得更强......他也已经足够好了......

scripts.text: Thank you. Thanks to you, I found out about Mao's troubles.
scripts.translation: 谢谢你，多亏了你，我知道了毛在烦恼什么。

scripts.text: Reported to Luanda and gained experience.
scripts.translation: 向卢安达报告，获得了经验值。

scripts.text: Told Luanda about someone who was taking something from the cave.
scripts.translation: 我把有人从洞穴里拿走东西的事告诉了卢安达。

scripts.text: You saw that too. I think we've talked about it before. In my dream, I saw monsters coming into town.
scripts.translation: 你也看见了啊。我们之前好像聊过这件事。我在梦里见到魔物涌进了村庄。

scripts.text: And in preparation for that time, the village warriors evacuated the elderly and weak to this place, and they stored supplies here and there in the cave.
scripts.translation: 为了应对那一天，村里的战士把老人和体弱者疏散到这里，还在洞穴各处藏了物资。

scripts.text: These are literally emergency items. It would be perfect if they were not used, but...
scripts.translation: 那些确实是应急物资。最好永远都用不上，可是......

scripts.text: You don't know how the world works. If you find something, just ignore it.
scripts.translation: 你还不懂世事。看到什么就当没看见吧。

scripts.text: Reported to Luanda and gained experience.
scripts.translation: 向卢安达报告，获得了经验值。

scripts.text: Told Luanda about the story of meeting the villagers and the village chief.
scripts.translation: 我把遇见村民和村长的经过告诉了卢安达。

scripts.text: You really came to see what happened a while ago. It wasn't as much damage as you saw in your dream, but it was a lot of damage.
scripts.translation: 你真的去看了那时发生的事。虽然没你梦里看到的那么严重，损失还是很惨重。

scripts.text: When I think of that day, my heart hurts. All of a sudden, when my brothers were away...
scripts.translation: 一想到那天，我就心痛。兄弟们突然都不在身边......

scripts.text: Still, the village chief, the best elder in the village, seems to have suffered less damage because he was calm. Thanks for the story.
scripts.translation: 不过村长是村里最年长、最德高望重的人，幸好他当时保持冷静，损失似乎小些。谢谢你告诉我这些。

scripts.text: Reported to Luanda and gained experience.
scripts.translation: 向卢安达报告，获得了经验值。

scripts.text: Told Luanda about the story of meeting the brothers who ran somewhere in a hurry.
scripts.translation: 我把遇到匆忙离开的兄弟们的事告诉了卢安达。

scripts.text: You must have seen the day my brothers and I came back from hunting. There was a big disaster in the village and it was the next day.
scripts.translation: 你看到的应该是我和兄弟们打猎回来那天。那场灾难是在隔天发生的。

scripts.text: Kuh.. If me and my brothers hadn't emptied the village... the people wouldn't have been taken by the monsters...
scripts.translation: 咳......要是我和兄弟们没把村民疏散出去，他们就会被魔物抓走......

scripts.text: I know. It's not because of me and my brothers.. but.. that day.. we.. .. .. it's just a pity
scripts.translation: 我知道。那不是我和兄弟们的错......可是......那天我们......唉......真让人难过。

scripts.text: You've shown me, adventurer, something I wouldn't have seen. I'm just here to tell you what I remember...
scripts.translation: 冒险者，你让我看到了本来不可能看到的事。我只是在这里告诉你我记得的事情......

scripts.text: Reported to Luanda and gained experience.
scripts.translation: 向卢安达报告，获得了经验值。

scripts.text: Told Luanda about the story of seeing Karu and Asudem.
scripts.translation: 我把看到卡鲁和阿苏德姆的事告诉了卢安达。

scripts.text: That's the reason why you shut yourself up in the west cave.
scripts.translation: ......所以你才把自己关在西边的洞穴里。

scripts.text: I feel resentful of myself for not being able to help with the village defense.
scripts.translation: 我怨恨自己没能帮忙守护村庄。

scripts.text: Your heart... I can't even imagine your sister-in-law's... whoo... your sorrow...
scripts.translation: 你的心情......我甚至不敢想象嫂子有多难受......唉......你一定很悲痛......

scripts.text: When the situation here is sorted out, I will look for my older brother. He must be alone in pain and sorrow.
scripts.translation: 这里的事情解决后，我要去找哥哥。他一定独自承受着痛苦和悲伤。

scripts.text: My heart hurts like this too, but if you know the youngest who struggles because of his abilities... I'll have to prepare. Thank you, adventurer.
scripts.translation: 我自己也很难受，可还有个弟弟正因自己的能力而苦恼......我得振作起来。谢谢你，冒险者。

scripts.text: Reported to Luanda and gained experience.
scripts.translation: 向卢安达报告，获得了经验值。

scripts.text: Told Luanda about stories of unknown people.
scripts.translation: 我把遇到一些陌生人的经历告诉了卢安达。

scripts.text: It sounds like a conversation between a Wootan or Megalith monster targeting the village.
scripts.translation: 听起来像是乌坦族或邪恶摩艾正打算袭击村庄。

scripts.text: Follow a strong leader? Recently, I felt that the movements of these guys are disturbingly orderly...
scripts.translation: 要追随强大的首领吗？最近这些家伙的行动确实整齐得反常......

scripts.text: It seems that a monster has appeared to lead them.
scripts.translation: 看来有个魔物出现，统领了它们。

scripts.text: It's embarrassing. Even now, all we can do is block it.
scripts.translation: 真惭愧。即使到了现在，我们也只能勉强挡住它们。

scripts.text: This is not the time to be sad. We need to build more defenses and take other measures.
scripts.translation: 现在不是难过的时候。我们得加强防御，再想想别的办法。

scripts.text: A strong leader is also a problem... but a power that has been handed down as a legend? This is a story I've never heard of before.
scripts.translation: 强大的首领已经够棘手了......传说中流传下来的力量？我从没听过这种事。

scripts.text: I'm guessing this is the reason why the monsters are attacking the village, but I'll have to tell the chief and investigate.
scripts.translation: 这大概就是魔物袭击村庄的原因。我得告诉村长，再调查清楚。

scripts.text: The story you just told me was really helpful. Thank you, adventurer.
scripts.translation: 你刚才告诉我的事很有帮助。谢谢你，冒险者。

scripts.text: Reported to Luanda and gained experience.
scripts.translation: 向卢安达报告，获得了经验值。

scripts.text: It's a situation where even one request is regrettable, but {0}... really.
scripts.translation: 哪怕少接一份委托都让人遗憾，不过......真 {0}

scripts.text: Each and every request is precious. Thank you again and again.
scripts.translation: 每一份委托都很重要。再次感谢你，辛苦了。

scripts.text: For quests that are recruiting in town, there is a separate request board.
scripts.translation: 城镇里的招募委托另有一块公告板。

scripts.text: Ah! Watch your mind. The location is in the middle of the battlefield, so I installed it in the corner for safety reasons.
scripts.translation: 啊，注意安全！公告板原本在战场中央，为了安全起见，我把它移到了角落。

scripts.text: There are cases where you cannot complete a request on the bulletin board right away, but there is no specific time limit, so don't be in a hurry.
scripts.translation: 公告板上的委托有时没法马上完成，不过没有时限，不用着急。

scripts.text: Adventurer, you are really curious about everything.
scripts.translation: 冒险者，你对什么都很好奇啊。

scripts.text: The Luanda Caves are strategically the only way out north of town.
scripts.translation: 卢安达洞窟是城镇北面的唯一通道，战略位置很重要。

scripts.text: That's why we're defending against monster attacks here.
scripts.translation: 所以我们才在这里抵御魔物的袭击。

scripts.text: Ah! Did you notice? Yes, my name is Luanda too. The village elders say...
scripts.translation: 啊，被你发现了？没错，我也叫卢安达。村里的长老说......

scripts.text: The triplets are said to have been named Karu, Luanda, and Mao after the village caves.
scripts.translation: 据说三胞胎卡鲁、卢安达和毛，是以村里的洞窟命名的。

scripts.text: My neighborhood friends teased me a bit when I was young, but I don't have any complaints about the name.
scripts.translation: 小时候，附近的朋友偶尔会拿这个名字开玩笑，不过我并不介意。

scripts.text: I heard they were named after the guardians of the village. I'm rather proud of them.
scripts.translation: 听说这些洞窟是村庄的守护者，我还挺为名字感到自豪的。

scripts.text: It's very puzzling to us too. If we knew why, we'd have put everything away.
scripts.translation: 我们也不清楚原因，实在令人费解。要是知道怎么回事，早就想办法解决了。

scripts.text: This isn't a town with plenty of food, and I don't think there's any particular reason for monsters to target it.
scripts.translation: 这里食物并不充裕，我不觉得魔物是为了什么特别的理由盯上村庄。

scripts.text: But what can we do? We're just living here, and the monsters keep coming, so we have to live while blocking them.
scripts.translation: 可我们又能怎么办？我们住在这里，魔物却不断来袭，只能一边抵挡一边过日子。

scripts.text: It's a bizarre shimmer that you're likely to be sucked into.
scripts.translation: 这是一道奇异的闪光，似乎会把人吸进去。

scripts.text: It seems like a phenomenon that can't be ignored. I'll have to talk to Luanda, the head of defense.
scripts.translation: 这种现象不能置之不理。我得去找防卫负责人卢安达谈谈。

Ah, you're the one introduced by Raket. I've been waiting for you.
scripts.translation: 啊，你就是拉凯特介绍来的那位吧。我等你好久了。

scripts.text: Can you show me your fishing rod?
scripts.translation: 能让我看看你的鱼竿吗？

scripts.text: What material are you talking about?
Adventurer, do you know where the deepest part of the sea is?
scripts.translation: 冒险者，你知道海洋最深处在哪里吗？

scripts.text: It is a place called the ^4d4dffTrench^000000. To put it simply, you can think of it as a deep cliff in the sea.
scripts.translation: 那个地方叫海沟。简单来说，就像海底的一道深渊。 ^4d4dff^000000

scripts.text: It is known that there are hundreds of different types of trenches in the world's oceans.
scripts.translation: 据说世界上的海洋里有数百条不同的海沟。

scripts.text: The widest and deepest known trench is the ^4d4dffBahia Trench^000000 near Izlude.
scripts.translation: 目前已知最宽、最深的海沟，是依斯鲁得附近的巴伊亚海沟。 ^4d4dff^000000

scripts.text: There are rare life forms at the bottom of the trench, and marine scientists like myself have shown great interest and have been exploring them.
scripts.translation: 海沟底部栖息着稀有生物。我和其他海洋学家对此很感兴趣，一直在研究它们。

scripts.text: Though shallow trenches can be explored to some extent.
scripts.translation: 浅海沟多少还能探索一番。

scripts.text: But in the case of the Bahia Trench, scientists have calculated that scientifically, no life can exist because it is so incredibly deep.
scripts.translation: 但巴伊亚海沟深不可测，科学家认为那里不可能存在生命。

scripts.text: I recently found out that there is life in the Bahia Trench.
scripts.translation: 最近我却发现，巴伊亚海沟里真的有生命。

scripts.text: You can tell by the stone that contains my magic.
scripts.translation: 从这块蕴含我魔力的石头就能看出来。

scripts.text: Yes, I'm a mage-turned-oceanographer. I learned magic for oceanography.
scripts.translation: 没错，我原本是魔法师，后来转行研究海洋。学习魔法就是为了做海洋研究。

scripts.text: Enchant a large boulder and make it fall to the floor where the trench exists.
scripts.translation: 我在巨石上施加魔法，再让它沉到海沟底部。

scripts.text: The magic on the dropped stone is connected to me, so by measuring the distance, I can get a little idea of how deep it is and what's going on near the stone.
scripts.translation: 沉下去的石头上的魔法会与我相连。通过测量距离，我就能大致判断海沟有多深，以及石头附近的状况。

scripts.text: To tell you what I found out...
scripts.translation: 我来告诉你发现了什么......

scripts.text: The composition of normal sea water and deep sea water is almost the same. But the only difference is the deep sea of Bahia Trench.
scripts.translation: 一般海水和深海海水的成分几乎相同，但巴伊亚海沟深处的海水却不一样。

scripts.text: Should I say it's like water and oil? There's a section where they never mix.
scripts.translation: 该怎么形容呢？就像水和油一样，有一层界面让两者永远无法混合。

scripts.text: A strong boundary was formed where they meet each other, and it felt as if the deep seawater in that section was desperately blocking the seawater coming down from above.
scripts.translation: 两种海水交界处形成了强力屏障，仿佛那里的深海水在拼命抵挡上方的海水。

scripts.text: The water pressure is also much lower than that of normal seawater, so it is assumed that it has a favorable environment for life.
scripts.translation: 那里的水压也低得多，所以我推测环境适合生命生存。

scripts.text: Is this gloss related to what you said?
scripts.translation: 这种光泽和你刚才说的发现有关吗？

scripts.text: We only identified the existence of Abyssal Seawater deep in the Bahia Trench, and it was very difficult to obtain samples. This fishing rod has a lot of Abyssal Seawater on it...
scripts.translation: 这样！我们只在巴伊亚海沟深处确认过深渊海水的存在，而且很难采集样本。这根鱼竿上却沾了不少......

scripts.text: Could you leave this fishing rod with me? I think I can figure something out if I extract this sea water and turn it into essence.
scripts.translation: 能把这根鱼竿留给我吗？我想提取海水并制成精华，说不定能查出些什么。

scripts.text: Oh, and I heard that the fishing rod was found today. Can I ask you to check if there is another floating substance in the nearby sea?
scripts.translation: 对了，听说这根鱼竿是今天才发现的。能帮我检查一下附近海域，看看有没有其他漂浮物吗？

scripts.text: I'm a bit busy right now...
Please come back to me when you're done!
Yes, thanks! I'll be waiting for you!!
I'm sorry to bother you, but please. I'll be waiting for you here.
scripts.translation: 抱歉打扰你，不过拜托了。我会在这里等你。

scripts.text: I'm sorry to bother you, but please. I'll be waiting for you here.
scripts.translation: 抱歉打扰你，不过拜托了。我会在这里等你。

scripts.text: Hey, could you take a look at this?
See those two little water bottles here?
scripts.translation: 看到这两小瓶海水了吗？

scripts.text: One side is normal seawater, and the other side is seawater mixed with seawater from the abyss buried in fishing rods. I'll try mixing these two.
scripts.translation: 一瓶是普通海水，另一瓶混有从鱼竿上提取的深渊海水。我来试着把它们混在一起。

scripts.text: - Jerrymon poured both waters into one bottle and began to shake them together. -
scripts.translation: - 杰里蒙把两种海水倒进同一瓶里，开始摇晃。 -

scripts.text: Now, look. As I said before, they don't mix at all, do they?
scripts.translation: 看到了吗？正如我刚才说的，两种水完全混不到一起。

scripts.text: If you shake it like crazy!!

scripts.translation: 呜哇啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊！！！！！！
啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊......

scripts.text: Oh, I'm going to catch someone, is it okay?
scripts.translation: 等等，我要去抓个人，可以吗？

scripts.text: - Looking into the bottle Jerrymon is holding, I can clearly see the shape of the vortex. -
scripts.translation: - 仔细看着杰里蒙手里的瓶子，我清楚地看见了漩涡的形状。 -

scripts.text: Now, do you see this whirlpool!! This is the passage that connects to the bottom of the Bahia Trench!
scripts.translation: 看见这个漩涡了吗？！这就是通往巴伊亚海沟底部的通道！

scripts.text: ??? Isn't that just a whirlpool created by shaking it?
No. This is the stone that contains my magical power. Let's look at it.
scripts.translation: 不是。这块石头蕴含着我的魔力，你看。

scripts.text: - Jerrymon put a glowing stone into the bottle. The glowing stone was sucked into the whirlpool inside the bottle and disappeared without a trace! -
scripts.translation: - 杰里蒙把发光的石头放进瓶里。石头被瓶中的漩涡吸了进去，转眼消失得无影无踪！ -

scripts.text: Did I ever tell you that the stone that contains my magic can measure the distance to me?
scripts.translation: 我有告诉过你吗？蕴含我魔力的石头可以测量它与我之间的距离。

scripts.text: It feels the same as the last time I threw a pebble into the Bahia Trench..
scripts.translation: 感觉和上次我把石子扔进巴伊亚海沟时一样..

scripts.text: If you follow this whirlpool, you may be able to find the owner of the fishing rod.
scripts.translation: ....顺着这个漩涡走，或许能找到鱼竿的主人。

scripts.text: The problem is... the amount of essence on a fishing rod can't make a whirlpool large enough for a person to fit in.
scripts.translation: 问题是......鱼竿上的精华不够多，无法形成足以让人通过的漩涡。

scripts.text: - Showed the ^4d4dff{0}^000000 received from Gein to Jerrymon. -
scripts.translation: - 把从盖因那里拿到的展示给杰里蒙。 - ^4d4dff{0}^000000

scripts.text: Oh, just in case, I actually found it!
With this amount, I think I can create a vortex of fissures that normal people can enter. You can pass it to me.
scripts.translation: 有了这些，我应该能制造出普通人也能进入的裂隙漩涡。把它交给我吧。

scripts.text: The place is too small to do this much here, so let's do it in Izlude. In order to get help from your friends.
scripts.translation: 这里空间太小，施展不开。我们去依斯鲁得岛吧，也好找你的朋友们帮忙。

scripts.text: I'm sorry to bother you, but please. I'll be waiting for you here.
scripts.translation: 抱歉打扰你了，不过拜托了。我会在这里等你。

scripts.text: I thought I'd never come back...
scripts.translation: 我还以为自己再也回不来了......

scripts.text: Hello, my name is Soup, a friend of Sirood who is missing.
scripts.translation: 你好，我叫汤，是失踪者西鲁德的朋友。

scripts.text: The four of us, Sirood, Raket, Gein, and I often enjoyed fishing.
scripts.translation: 我们四个人——西鲁德、拉凯特、盖因和我——经常一起钓鱼。

scripts.text: That windy day... I had been feeling very guilty for not stopping Sirood from going fishing.
scripts.translation: 那天风雨交加......我一直很自责，没能拦住西鲁德去钓鱼。

scripts.text: When I heard that Sirood's fishing pole was found, I jumped out.
scripts.translation: 听说找到了西鲁德的鱼竿，我立刻赶了过来。

scripts.text: You must have a clue about something?
scripts.translation: 你一定找到什么线索了吧？
希望西鲁德能平安回来。
西鲁德已经回到我们身边了。

scripts.text: Thanks to you, adventurer. Thank you very much.
scripts.translation: 多亏了你，冒险者。真的太感谢了。

scripts.text: It's been exactly 3 months since Sirood went missing.
scripts.translation: 西鲁德失踪到现在，正好三个月了。

scripts.text: Why is this only discovered now, isn't this a message from someone?
scripts.translation: 为什么偏偏现在才发现？会不会是有人留下了什么讯息？

scripts.text: Looking at it, it doesn't make sense.
Ha... It's just my delusion. I especially miss that child today.
scripts.translation: 唉......大概只是我想多了。尤其是今天，我特别想念那孩子。

scripts.text: Heh heh... It's so hard to use all your strength...
scripts.translation: 呵呵......要使出全力还真不容易......

scripts.text: Now you can fish with Sirood again.
scripts.translation: 现在你又能和西鲁德一起钓鱼了。

scripts.text: Please clean up your items and try again.
Haha... why did this only get discovered now??
scripts.translation: 哈哈......为什么偏偏现在才找到？！不

scripts.text: - I feel serious anguish from this person. Let's come back after I've become level 140. -
scripts.translation: - 我感受到他心中强烈的痛苦。等达到140级后再回来吧。 -

scripts.text: Haha...why did this only get discovered now??
scripts.translation: 哈哈......为什么偏偏现在才找到？！不

scripts.text: - He is very fidgety with a fishing pole in his hand. It doesn't look like he's out fishing. -
scripts.translation: - 他手里握着鱼竿，显得坐立不安。看起来不像是来钓鱼的。 -

scripts.text: This fishing rod belongs to my friend Sirood who went missing three months ago. I found something!!!
scripts.translation: 这根鱼竿属于我那位失踪三个月的朋友西鲁德。我找到线索了！！！

scripts.text: Yes... Sirood is a fishing fanatic and came here to fish whenever he had a chance.
scripts.translation: 是啊......西鲁德是个钓鱼迷，一有空就会来这里钓鱼。

scripts.text: Influenced by Sirood, we also fell in love with fishing, and the four of us often had a good time.
scripts.translation: 受他的影响，我们也爱上了钓鱼。我们四个人常常一起玩得很开心。

scripts.text: Sirood's passion for fishing was to the point that he invited us to go fishing even in the rain and wind.
scripts.translation: 西鲁德痴迷钓鱼，就算刮风下雨也会约我们出来。

scripts.text: The day Sirood went missing was exactly the same rainy and windy day. I put on my raincoat and went to go fishing.
scripts.translation: 西鲁德失踪那天，正好也是个风雨交加的日子。我穿上雨衣，准备去钓鱼。

scripts.text: We were invited to go out together, but they all declined.
scripts.translation: 他约我们一起出门，可大家都拒绝了。

scripts.text: Sirood went fishing alone and we haven't seen him since...
scripts.translation: 西鲁德只好独自去钓鱼，从那以后我们就再也没见过他......

scripts.text: I should have stopped you from leaving...
scripts.translation: 我真该拦住你，不让你出门......

scripts.text: - Gein started talking again after wiping away tears for a moment. -
scripts.translation: 盖因擦了擦眼泪，稍稍平复后又继续说。

scripts.text: The news of Sirood's disappearance immediately spread throughout Izlude and a large-scale search was conducted with a lot of time and manpower invested, but the search ended without finding any clues.
scripts.translation: 西鲁德失踪的消息很快传遍依斯鲁得岛。大家投入大量人力物力展开搜寻，可最后还是一无所获。

scripts.text: After that, we got together and ran everywhere to find Sirood, but there was no result, and we were about to give up.
scripts.translation: 后来我们几个又到处寻找西鲁德，仍然毫无结果，眼看就要放弃了。

scripts.text: Sirood's fishing pole has risen above sea level. His item was nowhere to be found during the search!
scripts.translation: 西鲁德的鱼竿浮出了海面。之前搜寻时，根本没找到他的任何物品！

scripts.text: Now, calm down... Are you sure it's Sirood's fishing rod?
scripts.translation: 先冷静......你确定那是西鲁德的鱼竿吗？

scripts.text: Yes, I'm sure! It's the fishing rod I've always seen.
scripts.translation: 当然确定！我一直都认得那根鱼竿。

scripts.text: This fishing rod was made by Sirood himself, so it is the only one. You can see the initials on the handle here, S.R.D!!
scripts.translation: 这是西鲁德亲手做的，独一无二。看，握柄上刻着他的名字缩写：S.R.D！！
咦，那为什么偏偏是现在......

scripts.text: I'm so surprised and shocked right now that I don't know what to do.
scripts.translation: 我现在又惊又慌，完全不知道该怎么办。

scripts.text: - But looking closely at the fishing rod, I feel something different. This wooden fishing rod has been submerged in water for 3 months, but it still looks the same, and I can see a bit of shiny gloss... -
scripts.translation: - 仔细观察鱼竿，我觉得有些异样。这根木制鱼竿在水里泡了三个月，外表却和原来一样，还泛着些微光泽...... -

scripts.text: Isn't this fishing rod a bit strange over there?
scripts.translation: 这根鱼竿是不是有点奇怪？

scripts.text: It's been submerged in water for 3 months... but it hasn't corroded at all. It's completely fine??
scripts.translation: 在水里泡了三个月......竟一点也没腐坏，完好无损？！

scripts.text: Hmm... And it seems to have a subtle glow... It seems like the fishing rod is coated?
scripts.translation: 嗯......而且还泛着微光，像是鱼竿表面覆了什么东西。

scripts.text: -The person who seemed to be Gein's friend who was listening to the story opened his mouth. -
scripts.translation: 一直听着盖因讲述、看起来像他朋友的人开口了。

scripts.text: Where is it, I want to see it!! What's wrong??
scripts.translation: 在哪儿？快给我看看！！怎么回事？

scripts.text: This fishing rod... It was submerged in the water for 3 months, but it was found in its original form, or worse, in a state of disrepair.
scripts.translation: 这根鱼竿......在水里泡了三个月，找到时却完好如初，甚至像是被修复过。

scripts.text: - Raket looked intently at his fishing pole, then answered Gein. -
scripts.translation: 拉凯特仔细端详自己的鱼竿，随后回答盖因。

scripts.text: Certainly!! I don't know, but would you?
scripts.translation: 没错！！我也不知道，你又怎么会知道呢？

scripts.text: Ummm... but I know someone who might know a little about this rod.
scripts.translation: 嗯......不过我认识一个人，或许对这根鱼竿有所了解。

scripts.text: His name is Jerrymon, a marine scientist. I've met my father a few times. I know you are in the East Library of Prontera.
scripts.translation: 他叫杰里蒙，是位海洋学家。我以前见过他几次，知道他在普隆德拉东图书馆。

scripts.text: Ah, ah... then... hey adventurer!! I'm sorry for the first meeting, but can I ask you a favor?? We can't get out of here in Izlude...
scripts.translation: 啊......这样啊。冒险者！抱歉刚见面就拜托你，能帮我们个忙吗？我们没法离开依斯鲁得......

scripts.text: Please go see Jerrymon and show him this fishing rod...even if it's trivial...I hope he has some information..
scripts.translation: 请去找杰里蒙，把这根鱼竿给他看看。哪怕能得到一点线索也好......

scripts.text: Sorry. I'm a bit busy right now...
Are you turning around after hearing about this heartbreaking story and mysterious clue...
scripts.translation: 听完这么令人心碎的故事，还发现了神秘线索......你就这样转身要走吗？

scripts.text: ^4d4dffJerrymon^000000 should still be at the <NAVI>[East Library]<INFO>prontera,192,264,</INFO></NAVI> in Prontera.
scripts.translation: 杰里蒙应该还在普隆德拉的<NAVI>[东图书馆]<INFO>prontera,192,264,</INFO></NAVI>。 ^4d4dff^000000

scripts.text: Now, I'll give you the fishing rod, a keepsake from Sirood. Thank you...
scripts.translation: 我把西鲁德留下的鱼竿交给你。请妥善保管......谢谢。

scripts.text: What??? It's a keepsake!! You don't even know if Sirood is alive or dead!!
scripts.translation: 什么？！这是遗物啊！你都不知道西鲁德是死是活呢！

scripts.text: Uhhh... yes I made a mistake, this is the fishing rod Sirood left behind. Please take good care of it.
scripts.translation: 呃......你说得对，是我失言了。这是西鲁德留下的鱼竿，麻烦你好好保管。

scripts.text: I'll tell Jerrymon about the contents in advance through my father!
scripts.translation: 我会先让我父亲把情况转告杰里蒙！

scripts.text: You can go to Prontera's <NAVI>[East Library]<INFO>prontera,192,264,</INFO></NAVI> as Raket told you.
scripts.translation: 照拉凯特说的，去普隆德拉的<NAVI>[东图书馆]<INFO>prontera,192,264,</INFO></NAVI>吧。

scripts.text: Take care of yourself!! I hope there is even the smallest clue...
scripts.translation: 保重！！希望能找到哪怕一点线索......

scripts.text: Do you have any information about Sirood?
- I relayed what I heard from Jerrymon. -

scripts.text: Ah... I see, I've never heard of a trench before.
scripts.translation: 啊......原来如此，我从没听说过海沟。

scripts.text: I can't believe there's such a big and deep trench near Izlude...
scripts.translation: 真不敢相信依斯鲁得附近竟然有这么宽、这么深的海沟......

scripts.text: Oh, by the way, is there anything else you need for coming back here?
scripts.translation: 对了，你回来时还发现其他东西了吗？

scripts.text: I was wondering if there was anything else found besides the fishing rod.

scripts.text: It's a chunk scooped up with a landing net near where the fishing rod was found.
scripts.translation: 这是在发现鱼竿附近用抄网捞上来的东西。

scripts.translation: 你要回去找杰里蒙吗？路上小心。

scripts.text: I hope Sirood will appear in front of us intact, just as the fishing rod appeared intact...
scripts.translation: 希望西鲁德也能像他的鱼竿一样，完好无损地出现在我们面前......

scripts.text: Please let me know if you have any new information!
scripts.translation: 有新消息的话，请一定告诉我！

scripts.text: Heh...heh...Hello adventurer, heh...heh... I'm so tired I can't move...
To be able to meet Sirood again is like a dream.
scripts.translation: 能再次见到西鲁德，就像做梦一样。

scripts.text: Please clean up your items and try again.
Wow... this purple sea... it's fantastic!!!
scripts.translation: 哇......这片紫色的海洋，简直太奇妙了！！！

scripts.text: It's so amazing that we can breathe without gills, there's no sea pressure, and even marine life that I've never seen before...!!!
scripts.translation: 不用鱼鳃也能呼吸，没有海水压力，甚至还有从没见过的海洋生物......！！！

scripts.text: There's more than one or two things to look into, I'll be busy.
scripts.translation: 值得调查的东西多得数不清，我可有得忙了。哇

scripts.text: Wow... so exciting!!! I think this is the most thrilling moment in my 14 years as an oceanographer!
scripts.translation: ......太让人激动了！！！这是我从事海洋研究14年来最兴奋的时刻！

scripts.text: Oh hey, I'm here to find Sirood...
scripts.translation: 哦，对了，我是来找西鲁德的......

scripts.text: Ah, ah... that, right? That should take precedence.
In order to bring Sirood back ashore, we need an additional ^4d4dff{0}^000000. The question is how to get it...
scripts.translation: 要把西鲁德带回岸上，还需要额外的^4d4dff{0}^000000。现在的问题是该怎么弄到……

scripts.text: I've been watching the deep sea creatures here, and I've seen some of them glow with the essence of the abyss.
scripts.translation: 我一直在观察这里的深海生物，发现有些身上散发着深渊精华的光芒。

scripts.text: And they seem to threaten us sometimes.
scripts.translation: 而且它们有时会威胁我们。
